dict.string: Frank uses other apps on your behalf — asking them and System Events to open pages, click, type, and report what is on screen — to carry out the tasks you ask for and to see which apps are open. Every action stays contained to one app, and this stays on your Mac.
Frank looks at the kinds of files on your Desktop and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
Frank looks at the kinds of files in your Documents and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
Frank looks at the kinds of files in your Downloads and which you have used recently, to tailor its help. It never reads their contents; this stays on your Mac.
Frank reads basic system information — hardware, uptime, connected devices — to tailor its help. This stays on your Mac.
